name: Weretiger

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

weaknesses.name: silver
weaknesses.details: (if the weretiger takes damage from a silver weapon, its regeneration does not function on its next turn)

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description:
Leather armor is sturdier than cloth armor. It protects vital areas with multiple layers of boiled-leather plates, while covering the limbs with supple leather that provides a small amount of protection.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Leather armor grants +3 AC at levels 16-25, and +4 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Katar
items.description: Also known as a punching dagger, this blade has an H-shaped handle that its wielder grasps in his or her fist. By driving this weapon at a foe with a punching motion, the katar’s wielder strikes with deep and deadly attacks.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

powers.name: Katar
powers.requirements: usable only while in humanoid form

powers.name: Bite
powers.requirements: usable only while in tiger form

hit.description: damage, and the target is exposed to moon rage (save ends)

effect.description: The weretiger makes two melee basic attacks. It shifts 1 square between the attacks

hit.description: damage, and the target is pushed 1 square and knocked prone. The weretiger then shifts into the target's vacated space

powers.name: Slashing Recoil
powers.trigger: when an attack misses the weretiger

effect.description: The weretiger makes a melee basic attack and shifts 2 squares.
A weretiger can alter its physical form to appear as a dire tiger or a unique humanoid.
